name: External Category Purpose 1 Code
definition: Specifies the category purpose, as published in an external category purpose code list.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

BONU.name: Bonus Payment
BONU.definition: Transaction is the payment of a bonus.

CASH.name: Cash Management Transfer
CASH.definition: Transaction is a general cash management instruction.

CBLK.name: Card Bulk Clearing
CBLK.definition: A service that is settling money for a bulk of card transactions, while referring to a specific transaction file or other information like terminal ID, card acceptor ID or other transaction details.

CCRD.name: Credit Card Payment
CCRD.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of credit card.

CORT.name: Trade Settlement Payment
CORT.definition: Transaction is related to settlement of a trade, eg a foreign exchange deal or a securities transaction.

DCRD.name: Debit Card Payment
DCRD.definition: Transaction is related to a payment of debit card.

DIVI.name: Dividend
DIVI.definition: Transaction is the payment of dividends.

DVPM.name: Deliver Against Payment
DVPM.definition: Code used to pre-advise the account servicer of a forthcoming deliver against payment instruction.

FCIN.name: Fee Collection And Interest
FCIN.definition: Transaction is related to the payment of a fee and interest.

FCOL.name: Fee Collection
FCOL.definition: A service that is settling card transaction related fees between two parties.

GP2P.name: Personto Person Payment
GP2P.definition: General Person-to-Person Payment. Debtor and Creditor are natural persons.

GOVT.name: Government Payment
GOVT.definition: Transaction is a payment to or from a government department.

HEDG.name: Hedging
HEDG.definition: Transaction is related to the payment of a hedging operation.

ICCP.name: Irrevocable Credit Card Payment
ICCP.definition: Transaction is reimbursement of credit card payment.

IDCP.name: Irrevocable Debit Card Payment
IDCP.definition: Transaction is reimbursement of debit card payment.

INTC.name: Intra Company Payment
INTC.definition: Transaction is an intra-company payment, ie, a payment between two companies belonging to the same group.

INTE.name: Interest
INTE.definition: Transaction is the payment of interest.

LBOX.name: Lockbox Transactions
LBOX.definition: Transaction is related to identify cash handling via Night Safe or Lockbox by bank or vendor on behalf of a physical store.

LOAN.name: Loan
LOAN.definition: Transaction is related to the transfer of a loan to a borrower.

PENS.name: Pension Payment
PENS.definition: Transaction is the payment of pension.

RPRE.name: Represented
RPRE.definition: Collection used to re-present previously reversed or returned direct debit transactions.

RRCT.name: Reimbursement Received Credit Transfer
RRCT.definition: Transaction is related to a reimbursement for commercial reasons of a correctly received credit transfer.

RVPM.name: Receive Against Payment
RVPM.definition: Code used to pre-advise the account servicer of a forthcoming receive against payment instruction.

SALA.name: Salary Payment
SALA.definition: Transaction is the payment of salaries.

SECU.name: Securities
SECU.definition: Transaction is the payment of securities.

SSBE.name: Social Security Benefit
SSBE.definition: Transaction is a social security benefit, ie payment made by a government to support individuals.

SUPP.name: Supplier Payment
SUPP.definition: Transaction is related to a payment to a supplier.

TAXS.name: Tax Payment
TAXS.definition: Transaction is the payment of taxes.

TRAD.name: Trade
TRAD.definition: Transaction is related to the payment of a trade finance transaction.

TREA.name: Treasury Payment
TREA.definition: Transaction is related to treasury operations.  E.g. financial contract settlement.

VATX.name: Value Added Tax Payment
VATX.definition: Transaction is the payment of value added tax.

WHLD.name: With Holding
WHLD.definition: Transaction is the payment of withholding tax.

SWEP.name: Cash Management Sweep Account
SWEP.definition: Classification: Cash Management. Transaction relates to a cash management instruction, requesting a sweep of the account of the Debtor above an agreed floor amount, up to a target or zero balance.|The purpose is to move the funds from multiple accounts to a single bank account. Funds can move domestically or across border and more than one bank can be used.

TOPG.name: Cash Management Top Account
TOPG.definition: Classification: Cash Management. Transaction relates to a cash management instruction, requesting to top the account of the Creditor above a certain floor amount, up to a target or zero balance. |The floor amount, if not pre-agreed by the parties involved, may be specified.

ZABA.name: Cash Management Zero Balance Account
ZABA.definition: Transaction relates to a cash management instruction, requesting to zero balance the account of the Debtor.|Zero Balance Accounts empty or fill the balances in accounts at the same bank, in the same country into or out of a main account each day.

VOST.name: Crossborder MI Payments
VOST.definition: Transaction to be processed as a domestic payment instruction originated from a foreign bank.

FCDT.name: Foreign Currency Domestic Transfer
FCDT.definition: Foreign Currency Transaction that is processed between two domestic financial institutions.

CIPC.name: Cash In Pre Credit
CIPC.definition: Transaction is a direct debit for a cash order of notes and/or coins.

CONC.name: Cash Out Notes Coins
CONC.definition: Transaction is a direct debit for a cash order of notes and/or coins.

CGWV.name: Carrier Guarded Wholesale Valuables
CGWV.definition: Transaction is a payment towards a Party for the collection of cash by the Cash in Transit company.

SAVG.name: Savings
SAVG.definition: Transfer to / from savings or to retirement account.

CTDF.name: Dodd Frank 1073 Payment
CTDF.definition: Cross border transaction initiated by US natural person that is subject to compliance with Dodd Frank 1073.

CPAY.name: Claim Payment
CPAY.definition: Transaction is related to the payment of a claim though a claim payment system.

CDIS.name: Additional Claim Disposition
CDIS.definition: Additional disposition following a claim payment made through a claim payment system.

CRYP.name: Crypto Assets
CRYP.definition: Transaction is related to the purchase or sale of crypto assets.
